items.title: Johnny St. Cyr Interview, 1958-08-27
items.q: guys that were supposed to be famous in those days, Joe Brooks and Rene Baptiste

ctx.x: Simplified, doesn't it? Yes, I know. It doesn't always harmonize. Two cards.

But I always tried to find chords that would harmonize. And try to find as many changes that would harmonize with the number as possible. I always had that natural sense of harmony. And that's the one thing that made me very popular as a guitar player. Because guys had been playing with the very, guys that were supposed to be famous in those days, Joe Brooks and Rene Baptiste. And those people, when I played the number I found so many changes in between what they played, that the guys wondered how I played it and…
